abort: stop on deadline, resource ceiling, nonfinite loss, missing parameter change, checkpoint mismatch or unexpected safety result; retain failed runs
backend: PyTorch CPU fp32, one intraop/inter-op thread per process, frozen tied token embeddings, other 2200 parameters trainable
cheaper_alternative: Existing CPU fixtures cover individual contracts but do not measure their composition with actual model inference, autograd, AdamW and checkpoint reload.
comparison: same CapabilityLoop, model, tasks, replay seed, batch budget and optimizer; minimal mode disables optional receipts, strict checkpoint binding/journal and allows lag<=999, guarded mode enables these with policy/verifier lag<=0; mandatory engine/group/report checks remain in both
decision: Accept only bounded system-composition evidence if three repetitions and fault oracles pass; no throughput improvement, model capability or distributed-scaling claim follows automatically.
hypothesis: Optional VARE reward authentication, strict freshness, checkpoint-bound evaluation and durable promotion reject injected invalid updates/publications at measurable single-host cost.
latency_details: Raw per-call spans; linear-interpolated p50/p95. Hook duration sums overlap for concurrent workers and are not critical-path time. Evaluation hook latency is per 32-task report; per-task service latency is also retained.
max_compute: free local CPU only, 60 minute campaign deadline, 120 second owned-job timeout, 12 GiB sampled process-tree RSS ceiling
memory_details: 20ms sampled sum of controller and descendant RSS, including shared mappings per process; CPU core percent uses sampled process CPU deltas, 100%=one core. Neither is a hardware memory/CPU reservation.
objective: mean -(reward - 0.5) * conditional log_probability, one AdamW step, lr=0.001, weight_decay=0
primary: generated rollout tasks / wall seconds from run_round dispatch through decision and exact active checkpoint recovery; generated tokens/s counts rollout output tokens only
promotion: nondecreasing independent mean probability of the correct constrained token, min_gain=0, n=32; diagnostic systems acceptance only, no statistical capability decision
sampling: one token sampled from the renormalized A/B logits; task-and-step seed independent of worker scheduling
scope: systems validation on a pretrained toy LM and fresh synthetic tasks; no research capability claim or reopening of retired studies
task: fresh nonce-tagged return-A transport fixture; independent evaluation uses disjoint nonce-tagged prompts and scorer, not a reasoning benchmark
timing_details: Both rollout/evaluation pools synchronize all initialized workers before measurement; one discarded fresh-model autograd/Adam warmup precedes comparisons. Each timed round ends with loading a new model and Adam instance from the active disk checkpoint. Cold pool startup is reported separately.
